mapper.select: SELECT activity_date AS date, category, SUM(activity_count) AS count FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{offsetSeconds}, created_at), '%Y-%m-%d') AS activity_date, 'conversations' AS category, COUNT(*) AS activity_count FROM agent_run WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < #{end} AND mode IN ('interactive', 'preview') GROUP BY activity_date, category UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{offsetSeconds}, created_at), '%Y-%m-%d') AS activity_date, CASE WHEN action IN ('schedule.create', 'schedule.update', 'schedule.enabled', 'schedule.upgrade', 'schedule.delete', 'schedule.run') THEN 'schedules' WHEN action IN ('todo.create', 'todo.update', 'todo.status', 'todo.transfer', 'todo.delete') THEN 'todos' ELSE 'employees' END AS category, COUNT(*) AS activity_count FROM audit_event WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND actor_user_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < #{end} AND result = 'success' AND ( (action IN ('schedule.create', 'schedule.update', 'schedule.enabled', 'schedule.upgrade', 'schedule.delete', 'schedule.run') AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(detail_redacted_json, '$.userActivity')) = 'true') OR action IN ('todo.create', 'todo.update', 'todo.status', 'todo.transfer', 'todo.delete', 'agent.hire.request', 'agent.hire.create', 'agent.hire.status', 'agent.hire.decision', 'agent.hire.withdraw') ) GROUP BY activity_date, category ) activities GROUP BY activity_date, category ORDER BY activity_date, category
